steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.inTime: Now the music doesn’t wait: after a bar counted in, sing each note as it reaches the line, and slide to the next one just as it arrives. First the app plays the melody, then you sing it, so you don’t need headphones.
steps.short: Listen, then sing: up three notes and back down, sliding from each one to the next.
steps.long: Long slides now, with time to settle on each note and hold it.
